mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% annualized over the past 3 months signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL annualized increase exceeds 2%.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5 percentage points over the past 3 months signals a tightening labor market, which boosts consumer confidence and spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of instances where UNRATE decreases by more than 0.5pp.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in Real Final Sales (RSAFS) over the past 6 months signals robust consumer demand, which drives corporate earnings and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of instances where RSAFS shows sustained growth.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in Industrial Production (INDPRO) by more than 1% over the past 3 months signals a contraction in supply, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as companies face reduced output and profitability.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where INDPRO decreases by more than 1%.

mechanism_narrative: When the Federal Funds Rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 4% and the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) is increasing, the combination signals a restrictive monetary policy environment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 4% and CPIAUCSL is increasing.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is below 5% and nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) increase by more than 200,000 in a month, the combination signals a strong labor market, boosting consumer spending and leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of instances where UNRATE < 5% and PAYEMS increases by more than 200k.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) over the past 6 months signals a strong demand for housing, which drives related industries and boosts the S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of instances where HOUST shows sustained growth.

mechanism_narrative: When Industrial Production (INDPRO) is increasing and Real GDP (GDPC1) is above its 12-month moving average, the combination signals a strong supply-side expansion, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of instances where INDPRO is increasing and GDPC1 is above its 12-month moving average.
